paite: TOUPA'N, ka TOUPA kiang ah, na melmate na khe ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi hi.
heading: David phatna La / TOUPA Leh Atel Kumpipa
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

paite: TOUPA'N na hatna chiang Zion tang a kipan in asawlkhe ding; nang nangmah doute lak ah vai hawm in.
english: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

paite: Na mite na thilhihtheihna ni ah amau ut thu in akipe zel uhi. Siangthou kilawmna ah, zingsang gilsung a kipan in, na valnou daitui na nei hi.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

paite: TOUPA akichiam a, akisik nawn kei ding, nang zaw Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi a, chi in.
english: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

paite: TOUPA na taklam a om in aheh ni in kumpipate anuaizan ding hi.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

paite: Namte lak ah vai ahawm ding a, munte siluang in ahihdim ding a, gam tampi ah lu asatzan ding hi.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

paite: Lam lak a luita adawn ding a; huaiziak in alu atawisang ding hi.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
